_editing: The Media page. Each group renders as its own labelled block; `layout` picks the card style (`article` = image + text card, `video` = 16:9 thumbnail with play affordance). To add an entry, copy an item and fill it in — set `url` to make the card clickable, and `image.src` to a file in /public/images. Delete the whole group if the campaign has nothing in that category. Every item below is a placeholder slot: nothing here is presented as real coverage.
